title: Big Ramsey combinatorics of the Cantor set and a simple proof of Blass' perfect set theorem
summary: In this paper we present a simple approach to big Ramsey combinatorics of the Cantor set $2^ω$. Using Infinite Dual Ramsey Theorem of Carlson and Simpson, we show that $2^ω$, viewed as a topological space, has finite big Ramsey degrees. We then examine several natural topological first-order structures arising from the Cantor set and prove that each of them inherits finite big Ramsey degrees. As a consequence, we obtain a simple proof of Blass' perfect set theorem, although our method does not recover the sharp bound $(n-1)!$ for the number of colors.
